findings.evidence: previous-version digest mui at dbff837f: 'removed units (122, showing 40)'. The digest lists only 40 of the 122 removed units. Each of the 40 shown resolves to a valid record row through sections.json, but the other 82 cannot be checked from the digest.
findings.fix: Regenerate the digest without the cap, or check the other 82 units against record.md and sections.json. Add a row in docs/audit/recovery/mui/record.md for any unit that has none.

findings.evidence: '**Loading.** While the title and body are not rendered yet, show `Skeleton` in their shape ...' and line 63 '**Icon-only buttons.** An `IconButton` has no accessible name of its own: set `aria-label` to the action'. These are activation reminders of general UI and accessibility practice, not v7 facts a model gets wrong.
findings.fix: Keep both bullets: the loading-card and theme-toggle evals depend on them. Move them out of 'v7 facts' into a short 'Defaults to apply' line so the v7 facts section holds only version facts. Do not delete them.

findings.evidence: '`references/theme-recipes.md`: ... Palette augmentation and CSS layers stay in `resources/theme-customization.md`.' Theme code is split across two parallel directories, resources/ and references/, with overlapping names. Every load trigger has to state which directory owns which part.
findings.fix: Use one directory for on-demand files (references/). Move the four resources/*.md files there, or merge theme-customization.md and theme-recipes.md. Update the pointers in SKILL.md and README.md, and record each move as `redistributed <path>` in docs/audit/recovery/mui/record.md.

findings.evidence: The 'files' entries mix two path roots. 'legacy-api.tsx' and 'outlined-input-theme.tsx' are in evals/files/, but 'resources/styling-guide.md', 'references/component-recipes.md', 'references/theme-recipes.md' and 'references/sx-and-styled-recipes.md' are relative to the skill root, not evals/files/. A runner that resolves files under evals/files/ will not find them.
findings.fix: Use one convention for every 'files' entry, for example skill-root paths such as 'evals/files/legacy-api.tsx' and 'references/component-recipes.md'. Or drop the skill's own reference files from 'files', because the skill loads them itself.

findings.evidence: Several negatives test nothing: 'Configure Vite for React.', 'Explain React server components in Next.js.', 'Explain CSS specificity.' share no MUI concept. The set also has 35 queries against the recommended ~20.
findings.fix: Replace the unrelated negatives with near-misses that share MUI terms but need something else, for example an MUI X Date Picker locale question or a Material Design 3 token question with no MUI code. Trim to about 20 queries split 10/10.

findings.evidence: 'v7 `Grid` is the former Grid2: `<Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>`, `offset` for gaps, no `item`.' `offset` shifts an item by whole columns. 'for gaps' reads like spacing, which is `spacing` / `rowSpacing` / `columnSpacing` on the container.
findings.fix: Reword: '`offset={{ md: 2 }}` to push an item right by columns (gutters are the container's `spacing`), no `item`.'
